name: Pydantic

summary: Pydantic welcomes the use of AI when contributing, including for code, but contributors must fully understand the code they submit. Maintainers may close any pull request at their discretion, including spam-like submissions or incoherent AI-generated PR descriptions, and can ban repeat offenders.

evidence.quote: We welcome the use of AI when contributing to Pydantic. However, users should certify that they fully understand the code being submitted.
We reserve the right to close any pull request at our discretion, without further justification. This includes, but is not limited to, cases where:
the pull request description is AI generated *and* incoherent or nonsensical.
the author appears to be mass-submitting pull requests across multiple repositories (spam),
